item: Settings repair keeps the Wikipedia lane's last known state
summary: Replacing damaged scheduler settings wrote wiki_lane_state halted every time, silently (the likely cause of OOS-3's multi-day pause). The repair now keeps the last known state from evidence (the lane state-change record, or a runner streaming in this process; the damaged row is never parsed), pauses only without any and records that pause as by settings-replacement, logs one WARNING naming every switch written OFF, and the config route answers written_off beside reset. Checked: only the scheduler replacement writes non-default values (six network switches OFF, deliberate); app and custody replacements reset to defaults. No UI reads reset or written_off yet (follow-up, needs x12 strings).
